entities.justification: Appears repeatedly as the buyer/party receiving satisfaction and rights to the estate, identified as 'Nicolao Raczka' and 'Nicolaus Raczka'.
Identified as the late widow 'Relictam olim Agnetem Kaczmirska' who previously recognized a sum of fifty florins.
Named as the late brother 'olim Stanislao Tarnawski' to whom Agnes recognized the sum of fifty florins.
Identified as 'praedicti Joannes Kaczkorowski', making the formal cession and admitting Nicolaus Raczka into possession.
Mentioned as 'Florenos quinquaginta' and 'quinquaginta florenorum' recognized by Agnes Kaczmirska.
The city of Lviv, referenced in 'Civitatis Leopoliensis' and 'Civitatis'.
The consular recording office before which Nicolaus Raczka personally registered ('coram Officio nostro') and in whose records ('Actis iisdem') the entry exists.
